detail: Replace per-member Skeleton3D+AnimationPlayer subtrees with one MultiMeshInstance3D per (model, team, clip) and a bone-atlas texture sampled in the shader. member_render_batcher.gd and skinned_pose_baker.gd are the starting point; the far-distance tier becomes the only path.
oracle: render_benchmark_runner: 144 fps at 10000 members on the reference GPU; retail_state_pin unchanged
title: Draw every member through MultiMesh with baked bone-atlas animation
